svg.aria-label: Açık Defter — An IT student's open notebook. A lined school notebook on a desk — red margin, stitched spine, bookmark tabs; dark mode is the same notebook under a lamp. Four languages, right-to-left in Persian, readable offline, checked in a real browser.
